title: Equalities among simplest quartic fields: a complete classification
summary: For a positive integer $n$, let $f_n(X)=X^4-nX^3-6X^2+nX+1$ and let $K_n=\mathbb{Q}(ρ_n)$, where $ρ_n$ is a root of $f_n$. We determine all coincidences among these fields: for distinct positive integers $m,n$, $K_m=K_n \Longleftrightarrow \{m,n\}\in\{\{1,103\},\{2,22\},\{4,956\}\}$. Thus the three previously known equalities are the only ones. This extends Hoshi's finite-range classification to all positive integral parameters and, in particular, subsumes the uniqueness results of Pincus and Washington.
